agent.finish_summary: Fixed the issue672 regression in sqlparse/tokens.py: _TokenType.__getattr__ now raises AttributeError for dunder-style names (e.g. __deepcopy__, __reduce_ex__) instead of creating a new _TokenType for them. Previously, probing for such special methods (as copy.deepcopy/copy.copy/pickle do) found a truthy non-callable _TokenType instance and attempting to call it raised 'TypeError: _TokenType object is not callable'. Verified copy.deepcopy/copy.copy/pickle round-trips on token types and full parsed statements work correctly, and normal token attribute access (Token.Keyword, Literal.String, etc.) remains unaffected.
